title: TONSTAD table
description: TONSTAD table, off-white, 59x311/2" TONSTAD series blends classic design with a graceful matte off-white finish, giving each piece a solid sense of quality. This dining table for 4 is generously dimensioned for memorable moments.
features: To prevent surface scratches, complete with TRIXIG stick-on floor protectors, sold separately.
A bit screwdriver is required to assemble this table, sold separately as a part of TRIXIG 15-piece toolset.
Matches well with TONSTAD, GRÖNSTA, KRYLBO and TOSSBERG chairs, sold separately.
Combines with other products in the TONSTAD series.
materialAndCare: Top panel: Particleboard, Acrylic paint, Melamine foil, Plastic edging; Side rail/ Leg: Solid wood, Adhesive, Acrylic paint
